pages: 原书 p. 69–96（七部连环词条）
ocr_note: 本词条为全书篇幅最大的七部连环词条（作者在导言中特别说明的『基督徒生活』系列）。本页现已完成第一、二部分，其余部分随翻译进度陆续补入。原书 p. 73–74 之间一栏内容（第二部分『见证人』末段与第三部分的标题及开头）在扫描中丢失，已标注。

blocks.en: CHRISTIAN LIFE: I. CHRISTIAN; II. FIGURATIVE PRESENTATIONS; III. CHRISTIAN EXPERIENCE; IV. CHRISTIAN CHARACTER; V. CHRISTIAN WALK; VI. CHRISTIAN WORK; VII. WATCHWORDS OF COUNSEL AND PROMISE.
blocks.zh: 基督徒生活：一、基督徒（之名）；二、形象化的表述（人生五喻）；三、基督徒经历；四、基督徒品格；五、基督徒行事；六、基督徒工作；七、劝勉与应许的口号。

grammar.note: 七个并列标题构成全词条纲目——这是作者在全书导言里特别提到的精心组织的连环词条。

sections.heading: 一、基督徒——属基督的人 / I. Christian: One Belonging to Christ

blocks.en: CHRISTIAN, One belonging to Christ (N. T.). Acts 11:26. The disciples were called Christians (first in Antioch). XI. 82. Acts 26:28. (Almost thou persuadest me) to be a Christian. 1 Pet. 4:16. If any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed.
blocks.zh: 基督徒——属基督的人（新约用语）。使徒行传 11:26 —— 门徒称为基督徒是从安提阿起首。26:28 —— 亚基帕对保罗说：你这样劝我，几乎叫我作基督徒了！彼得前书 4:16 —— 若为作基督徒受苦，却不要羞耻，倒要因这名归荣耀给神。

grammar.note: let him not be ashamed：Let + 第三人称的否定祈使（却不要羞耻）。

blocks.en: Equivalent or Synonymous Terms. Disciple—a taught or trained one (in the Gospels and Acts). Matt. 10:24, 25. The disciple is not above his Master. John 8:31. If ye continue in My word, then are ye truly My disciples. John 15:8. Bear much fruit; so shall ye be My disciples. Love to the brethren a chief test and evidence: John 13:35. By this shall all men know that ye are My disciples, if ye have love one to another. 1 John 3:14.
blocks.zh: 同义的称呼。门徒——受教受训的人（福音书与使徒行传用语）。马太福音 10:24-25 —— 学生不能高过先生。约翰福音 8:31 —— 你们若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的门徒。15:8 —— 你们多结果子……这样就是我的门徒了。爱弟兄是首要的凭据：13:35 —— 你们若有彼此相爱的心，众人因此就认出你们是我的门徒了。另参约翰一书 3:14。

grammar.note: then are ye truly My disciples / so shall ye be My disciples / By this shall all men know：三处状语开头引起的倒装。

blocks.en: Believer—one that trusteth in Christ (N. T.). John 3:16. Whosoever believeth in Him should not perish. John 11:25, 26. He that believeth in Me shall never die. Acts 13:39. By Him every one that believeth is justified. Rom. 1:16. The Gospel, the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth. 2 Tim. 1:12. I know Whom I have believed. 1 Pet. 1:8. Believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable. The believer a temple of the Holy Ghost: 1 Cor. 3:16.
blocks.zh: 信徒——信靠基督的人（新约用语）。约翰福音 3:16 —— 叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，反得永生。11:25-26 —— 信我的人，虽然死了，也必复活；凡活着信我的人必永远不死。使徒行传 13:39 —— 你们靠摩西的律法……不得称义的一切事，信靠这人，就都得称义了。罗马书 1:16 —— 这福音本是神的大能，要救一切相信的。提摩太后书 1:12 —— 因为知道我所信的是谁。彼得前书 1:8 —— 却因信他就有说不出来、满有荣光的大喜乐。信徒是圣灵的殿：哥林多前书 3:16。

grammar.note: one that trusteth / He that believeth / every one that believeth：that 指人的定语从句贯穿全段。

blocks.en: Follower (Imitator) of Christ. Matt. 19:21. Come, follow Me. John 8:12. He that followeth Me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life. Eph. 5:1. Be ye followers (imitators) of God, as dear children. Servant (Slave) of Christ. John 12:26. Where I am, there shall also My servant be. John 15:15. No longer do I call you servants … but I have called you friends.
blocks.zh: 跟从者（效法者）。马太福音 19:21 —— 来跟从我。约翰福音 8:12 —— 跟从我的，就不在黑暗里走，必要得着生命的光。以弗所书 5:1 —— 所以你们该效法神，好像蒙慈爱的儿女一样。仆人（奴仆）。约翰福音 12:26 —— 我在哪里，服事我的人也要在那里。15:15 —— 以后我不再称你们为仆人……我乃称你们为朋友。

grammar.note: there shall also My servant be / No longer do I call you servants：状语前置引起的倒装两例。

blocks.en: Righteous, Upright (O. T. chiefly). Ps. 5:12. The Lord will bless the righteous. Ps. 146:8. The Lord loveth the righteous. Prov. 14:32. The righteous hath hope in his death. Prov. 18:10. The righteous runneth into it (the name of the Lord, a strong tower), and is safe. Isa. 3:10. Say ye of the righteous, that it shall be well with him. Matt. 13:43. Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. Matt. 25:46. Life eternal. (All "great and precious promises.")
blocks.zh: 义人、正直人（主要为旧约用语）。诗篇 5:12 —— 因为你必赐福与义人。146:8 —— 耶和华喜爱义人。箴言 14:32 —— 义人临死，有所投靠。18:10 —— 耶和华的名是坚固台，义人奔入便得安稳。以赛亚书 3:10 —— 你们要论义人说：他必享福乐。马太福音 13:43 —— 那时，义人在他们父的国里，要发出光来，像太阳一样。25:46 —— 义人要往永生里去。（这些全是『又宝贵又极大的应许』。）

grammar.note: the righteous：义人——本段全部经文的主语（the + 形容词表一类人的又一密集用例）。

blocks.en: Good Man. Prov. 12:2. Shall obtain favor of the Lord. Prov. 13:22. Leaveth an inheritance to his children's children. Prov. 14:14. Shall be satisfied from himself. Acts 11:24. He was a good man, full of the Holy Ghost and of faith. 2 Kings 4:9. A man of God. Godly. Ps. 12:1. The godly man ceaseth. Ps. 86:2. 2 Pet. 2:9. The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly.
blocks.zh: 善人。箴言 12:2 —— 善人必蒙耶和华的恩惠。13:22 —— 善人给子孙遗留产业。14:14 —— 善人必从自己的行为得以知足。使徒行传 11:24 ——（巴拿巴）原是个好人，被圣灵充满，大有信心。列王纪下 4:9 —— 神人（以利沙）。虔诚人。诗篇 12:1 —— 虔诚人断绝了（世间的虔诚人何其稀少）。86:2；彼得后书 2:9 —— 主知道搭救敬虔的人脱离试探。

blocks.en: Saints—Set-apart, Holy, Beloved, or Gracious Ones. (The term most frequently used in both Testaments.) Passages full of helpful promise: 1 Sam. 2:9. He will keep the feet of His saints. Ps. 34:9. No want to them that fear Him. Ps. 116:15. Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints. 1 Cor. 1:2. Called to be saints. 1 Cor. 6:2, 3. The saints shall judge the world … and angels. Eph. 4:12. For the perfecting of the saints. Col. 1:12. The inheritance of the saints in light. 2 Thes. 1:10. Glorified in His saints. Children, or Sons, of God. Ps. 103:13. Rom. 8:15-17. Gal. 3:26. 1 John 3:1, 2. Behold what manner of love … that we should be called children of God: and such we are. For contrasts, see Wicked; Unrighteous.
blocks.zh: 圣徒——被分别出来的、圣洁蒙爱的人。（新旧两约使用最频繁的称呼。）满有应许的经文：撒母耳记上 2:9 —— 他必保护圣民的脚步。诗篇 34:9 —— 敬畏他的一无所缺。116:15 —— 在耶和华眼中，看圣民之死极为宝贵。哥林多前书 1:2 —— 奉召作圣徒。6:2-3 —— 岂不知圣徒要审判世界吗？……岂不知我们要审判天使吗？以弗所书 4:12 —— 为要成全圣徒。歌罗西书 1:12 —— 在光明中同得基业。帖撒罗尼迦后书 1:10 —— 他……在他圣徒的身上得荣耀。神的儿女。诗篇 103:13；罗马书 8:15-17；加拉太书 3:26；约翰一书 3:1-2 —— 你看父赐给我们是何等的慈爱，使我们得称为神的儿女，我们也真是他的儿女。对照的称呼参主题词条：恶人（Wicked）；不义的人（Unrighteous）。

grammar.note: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of His saints：表语前置引起倒装（圣民之死在耶和华眼中极为宝贵）。

sections.heading: 二、形象化的表述：受教育的一生与人生五喻 / II. Figurative Presentations

blocks.en: CHRISTIAN LIFE A PERIOD OF EDUCATION for the future, perfected being—involving a process of discipline, training and testing unto the end. Some characteristics and processes, as represented under familiar figures, showing hardships, temptations, perils, and obligations, with methods of meeting, fulfilling, enduring and overcoming.
blocks.zh: 基督徒的一生是一段教育时期——为着将来那完全的存在；其间包含直到末了的管教、训练与试验的过程。以下借几个人所熟悉的比方，呈现这一生的特征与进程：其艰难、试探、危险与责任，以及迎战、尽责、忍耐、得胜的方法。

grammar.note: CHRISTIAN LIFE (is) A PERIOD OF EDUCATION：标题句省略系动词；unto the end：直到末了（unto 古体）。

blocks.en: 1. Life as a Warfare; the Christian as a Soldier. Opposing and assaulting powers: The Flesh, or the old nature, in life-long conflict with the new (see Flesh and Spirit). 1 Pet. 2:11. Fleshly lusts, which war against the soul. James 4:1. Worldly associations and interests: Rom. 12:2. Be not conformed to this world. 2 Cor. 6:17. Come ye out from among them. The powers of darkness: 2 Cor. 10:3-5. Eph. 6:11, 12. Against the wiles of the devil; against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world. James 4:7. Resist the devil. 1 Pet. 5:8, 9. Resist, steadfast in the faith. Rom. 16:20. The God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly.
blocks.zh: 1. 人生如争战；基督徒是精兵。敌对进攻的势力有三：肉体（旧性情），与新性情终生交战（另参主题词条：肉体与圣灵）——彼得前书 2:11：肉体的私欲，这私欲是与灵魂争战的；雅各书 4:1。属世的交往与利益——罗马书 12:2：不要效法这个世界；哥林多后书 6:17：你们务要从他们中间出来。幽暗的权势——哥林多后书 10:3-5；以弗所书 6:11-12：要抵挡魔鬼的诡计；因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的……争战。雅各书 4:7：务要抵挡魔鬼。彼得前书 5:8-9：用坚固的信心抵挡他。罗马书 16:20：赐平安的神快要将撒但践踏在你们脚下。

grammar.note: Be not conformed：古体否定祈使（参 004 词条首注）。
principalities：执政的（天空属灵气的恶势力等级，principality 此处非『公国』义）。

blocks.en: The Soldier's Armor. Eph. 6:14-17. The Helmet of Salvation (the hope of salvation, 1 Thes. 5:8); the Breastplate of righteousness (of faith and love); the Shield of faith; the Girdle of truth, binding all together; the Sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God. Divine Orders and Counsels: 2 Tim. 2:3. Suffer hardship with me, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus. 1 Tim. 1:18. War the good warfare. 1 Tim. 6:12. Fight the good fight of the faith; lay hold on eternal life. 2 Tim. 4:7. I have fought the good fight.
blocks.zh: 精兵的军装。以弗所书 6:14-17 —— 救恩的头盔（帖撒罗尼迦前书 5:8 作『得救的盼望当作头盔』）；公义的护心镜（帖前作『把信和爱当作护心镜遮胸』）；信德的藤牌；真理的带子（束住全身）；圣灵的宝剑，就是神的道。主的军令与劝勉：提摩太后书 2:3 —— 你要和我同受苦难，好像基督耶稣的精兵。提摩太前书 1:18 —— 打那美好的仗。6:12 —— 你要为真道打那美好的仗，持定永生。提摩太后书 4:7 —— 那美好的仗我已经打过了。

grammar.note: War the good warfare / Fight the good fight：两组同源宾语结构（war a warfare / fight a fight——打那仗）。

blocks.en: Watching and waiting in trust and prayer, and standing fast in the good fight, is the order and detail of the Christian soldier's duty. Loyalty to truth and duty, and devotion to the Sovereign and to the interests of the Kingdom, are the principles that inspire and sustain him in the discomfort and weariness of camp and march, and in the sacrament of conflict. 1 Cor. 16:13. Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong. Eph. 6:10, 11. Be strong in the Lord. Put on the whole armor of God. O. T. texts: Ex. 14:13. Stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord. 2 Chron. 20:15-17. The battle is not yours, but God's. 1 Kings 2:2. Be thou strong, and show thyself a man. Josh. 1:6-8. Christ the Captain: Josh. 5:14. As Captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. Heb. 2:10. The Captain of their salvation, made perfect through sufferings.
blocks.zh: 在信靠祷告中警醒等候、在美好的争战中站立得稳，是基督精兵日课的全部条目。对真理与本分的忠诚，对君王和国度利益的忠贞，是他在营地行军的劳顿疲惫中、在争战这神圣职事中得以振奋支撑的原则。哥林多前书 16:13 —— 你们务要警醒，在真道上站立得稳，要作大丈夫，要刚强。以弗所书 6:10-11 —— 你们要靠着主，倚赖他的大能大力，作刚强的人。要穿戴神所赐的全副军装。旧约经文：出埃及记 14:13 —— 只管站住！看耶和华今天向你们所要施行的救恩。历代志下 20:15-17 —— 胜败不在乎你们，乃在乎神。列王纪上 2:2 —— 你当刚强，作大丈夫。约书亚记 1:6-8。基督是元帅：约书亚记 5:14 —— 我来是要作耶和华军队的元帅。希伯来书 2:10 —— 要领许多的儿子进荣耀里去，使救他们的元帅因受苦难得以完全。

grammar.note: As Captain of the host of the Lord am I now come：表语前置＋古体完成式 am come（= have come）的倒装。
quit you like men：quit + 反身宾语的古用法（作大丈夫，参 004 词条）；Be thou strong：祈使句保留主语 thou。

blocks.en: [Strength comes to the soul from struggle. Its opposing forces are temptations, inborn moral weaknesses, natural tendencies toward wrong-doing—toward selfishness, deceit, envy, wrath, malice, covetousness, arrogance, rebelliousness, and a host of other spiritual foes that war in and against the soul. "We wrestle not against flesh and blood," says Paul, "but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." These wrestlings of the soul are carried on in silence, in solitude. Oh, what battles are fought, what long-continued wrestlings does every soul know, that once enters the lists against these foes of the spirit! What struggles against evil dispositions, against distrust of God, against unbelief, against temptations to secret wrong-doing, against hatred and envy and all uncharitableness! But if, by help of the Divine Spirit that is ever ready to come to our aid if we but desire it, we come off conquerors, the next battle will be easier, the next struggle less prolonged. Having gained, we shall go on from strength to strength. — Interior.]
blocks.zh: 【摘录】力量借争战临到灵魂。它的敌军是：试探、与生俱来的道德软弱、种种趋向行恶的天然倾向——趋向自私、诡诈、嫉妒、恼怒、恶毒、贪婪、傲慢、悖逆，以及在灵魂之内、向灵魂开战的许许多多属灵仇敌。保罗说：『我们并不是与属血气的摔跤，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔摔跤。』灵魂的这些搏斗，都在寂静里、在孤独中进行。哦，凡曾入场迎战这些心灵之敌的灵魂，谁不知道其中打过怎样的仗、经过怎样旷日持久的摔跤！与恶劣性情的搏斗，与对神的不信任、与不信、与暗中行恶的试探、与仇恨嫉妒和一切刻薄的搏斗！然而——那位圣灵随时预备帮助我们，只要我们肯求——我们若靠他的帮助得胜而回，下一仗就更容易，下一场搏斗就不再那么漫长。既已得胜，我们就要力上加力地往前去。——《Interior》杂志

grammar.note: We wrestle not against flesh and blood：古体否定（我们并不是与属血气的摔跤）。
what battles are fought, what long-continued wrestlings does every soul know：双重感叹句，第二句感叹宾语前置引起倒装；enters the lists：习语『入场比武』（lists 古义：比武场的围栏）；if we but desire it：but 古义『只要，仅仅』（= only）。

blocks.en: 2. Life as a Competitive Contest; the Christian as an Athlete, seeking the crown-laurel in the games. Chief passages: 1 Cor. 9:24-27. Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain. … I buffet my body, and bring it into bondage. Phil. 3:12-14. Heb. 12:1, 2. Lay aside every weight … and run with patience the race that is set before us, looking unto Jesus. 2 Tim. 2:5. If a man contend in the games, he is not crowned, except he have contended lawfully. 2 Tim. 4:7. I have finished the course. Allusions: Gal. 2:2; 5:7. Phil. 2:16.
blocks.zh: 2. 人生如竞赛；基督徒是运动员，在赛会中夺取桂冠。主要经文：哥林多前书 9:24-27 —— 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。……我是攻克己身，叫身服我。腓立比书 3:12-14（向着标竿直跑）。希伯来书 12:1-2 —— 就当放下各样的重担，脱去容易缠累我们的罪，存心忍耐，奔那摆在我们前头的路程，仰望……耶稣。提摩太后书 2:5 —— 人若在场上比武，非按规矩，就不能得冠冕。4:7 —— 当跑的路我已经跑尽了。另有隐喻：加拉太书 2:2；5:7（你们向来跑得好）；腓立比书 2:16。

grammar.note: except he have contended lawfully：except（= unless）从句用 have 原形完成式，虚拟语气（非按规矩就不能得冠冕）。
Know ye not…?：古体疑问（岂不知……吗）；So run, that ye may obtain：so…that 此处为『当这样跑，好叫……』的目的结构。

blocks.en: 3. Life as a Journey or Pilgrimage; the Christian a Pilgrim, a Sojourner. Lev. 25:23. Ye are strangers and sojourners with Me. Ps. 39:12. I am a stranger with Thee, a sojourner, as all my fathers were. Ps. 119:19. I am a sojourner in the earth. Ps. 119:54. Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage. Heb. 11:13. Confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth. 1 Pet. 2:11. As sojourners and pilgrims.
blocks.zh: 3. 人生如旅程或客旅；基督徒是天路客、寄居者。利未记 25:23 —— 你们在我面前是客旅，是寄居的。诗篇 39:12 —— 我在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我列祖一般。119:19 —— 我是在地上作寄居的。119:54 —— 我在世寄居，素来以你的律例为诗歌。希伯来书 11:13 —— 又承认自己在世上是客旅，是寄居的。彼得前书 2:11 —— 你们是客旅，是寄居的。

blocks.en: 4. Life as a Trust, a Stewardship to be accounted for; the Christian a Trustee, a Steward. Luke 12:42, 48. Who then is the faithful and wise steward? … To whomsoever much is given, of him shall much be required. Luke 16:2. Give an account of thy stewardship. Luke 19:13. Trade ye herewith till I come. 1 Cor. 4:1, 2. Stewards of the mysteries of God: it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful. 2 Tim. 4:7. I have kept the faith. 1 Pet. 4:10. As good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
blocks.zh: 4. 人生如受托，是一场要交账的管家职分；基督徒是受托人、管家。路加福音 12:42, 48 —— 谁是那忠心有见识的管家……多给谁，就向谁多取。16:2 —— 把你所经管的交代明白。19:13 —— 你们去做生意，直等我回来。哥林多前书 4:1-2 —— 神奥秘事的管家。所求于管家的，是要他有忠心。提摩太后书 4:7 —— 所信的道我已经守住了。彼得前书 4:10 —— 作神百般恩赐的好管家。

grammar.note: To whomsoever much is given, of him shall much be required：whomsoever 引导让步性关系从句＋主句倒装（多给谁，就向谁多取）；that a man be found faithful：主语从句用 be 原形，虚拟语气。

blocks.en: 5. Life as a Witnessing, a Testimony for God, for His truth and His claims; the Christian a Witness in life and character, an Epistle of Christ, a Light-bearer. Isa. 43:10. Ye are My witnesses, saith the Lord. Acts 1:8. Ye shall be My witnesses … unto the uttermost part of the earth. 2 Cor. 3:2, 3. Ye are our epistle … an epistle of Christ, known and read of all men. Matt. 5:13-16. Ye are the salt of the earth. Ye are the light of the world. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father. Phil. 2:15, 16. Seen as lights in the world, holding forth the word of life. Heb. 11. The cloud of witnesses. Add John the Baptist and Stephen among the martyrs; and include every Bible record of godly character, deed and life.
blocks.zh: 5. 人生如见证，是为神、为他的真理与主权作的证词；基督徒在生活与品格上是见证人，是基督的书信，是持光者。以赛亚书 43:10 —— 耶和华说：你们是我的见证。使徒行传 1:8 —— 直到地极，作我的见证。哥林多后书 3:2-3 —— 你们就是我们的荐信……你们明显是基督的信，众人所知道所念诵的。马太福音 5:13-16 —— 你们是世上的盐……你们是世上的光……你们的光也当这样照在人前，叫他们看见你们的好行为，便将荣耀归给你们在天上的父。腓立比书 2:15-16 —— 好像明光照耀，将生命的道表明出来。希伯来书 11 章 —— 如同云彩围着的见证人。可再加上殉道者中的施洗约翰与司提反，以及圣经所记一切敬虔品格、敬虔行事与生命的记录。【OCR 注：本段末尾与第三部分的标题及开头约一栏内容在扫描中丢失，第三部分现存文本自 p. 74 中途起。】

grammar.note: known and read of all men：of 引施动者（为众人所知所读）；holding forth the word of life：hold forth『举着，表明』（将生命的道举在人前）。
